curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a young woman find love while seeking vengeance after being taken prisoner in the Amazon?
curatedMovie.description: After her parents are killed in the Amazon, a young woman is taken prisoner by an indigenous tribe of headhunters as she seeks vengeance and finds love.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, heavy, and intensely suspenseful solo viewing driven by visceral jungle danger.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Mario Gariazzo’s 1985 Italian adventure blends harrowing jungle horror with an urgent tale of captivity and retribution.
